title: MDG Operations Event v1
description: A single derived, append-only, non-authoritative operations event. Events DESCRIBE what was observed about the live Hermes Kanban system; they never change it. Hermes Kanban remains the sole live task authority. All timestamps are UTC ISO-8601. observation time (observed_at) is distinct from event occurrence time (occurred_at).

event_id.description: Deterministic, collision-resistant identifier. Immutable once written. Identical re-append of the same event_id+content is idempotent; same event_id with different content fails closed.

occurred_at.description: When the event is understood to have occurred in the modeled system. For left-censored first observations this MUST equal observed_at and the event MUST set censoring.left_censored=true. NEVER back-fill from card update times, comments, Git commit dates, file mtimes, or prose handoffs.

observed_at.description: When the observer actually read the source state. Monotonic non-decreasing across observations; out-of-order observed_at is rejected.

task_id.description: Stable task/card identifier from the source system. Required for task-scoped event types.

initiative_id.description: Parent initiative identifier, if the task belongs to one.

from_state.description: Normalized prior state for a transition. Null for first observation (unknown prior state).

to_state.description: Normalized new state. Uses the normalized_state vocabulary, NOT the raw Hermes status.

source_system.description: Which system the observation was read from.

source_ref.description: Opaque source reference (board slug, worktree path, lease file). Private detail; never a credential.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw source input this event was derived from. Enables idempotent re-observation: identical source hash produces no duplicate events.

base_sha.description: Git base SHA the task was authored against, when known.

lease_paths.description: Normalized, sorted lease paths for lease events.

depends_on.description: Dependency task identifiers observed on the task.

reason_code.description: Machine-readable reason (e.g. dependency, capability, needs_input, transient, verification_fail).

provenance.description: How this event entered the ledger. 'live_observer' = derived by the OPS-03 observer from a fresh snapshot. 'historical_import' = ingested one-time from the Hermes board SQLite task_events/task_runs log (structured history beginning at a documented cutoff). Imported events MUST also set import_batch and MUST NOT carry inferred timestamps.

import_batch.description: Identifier of the historical-import batch (e.g. 'hermes-task-events-2026-07-14'). Required when provenance is historical_import; null otherwise. Records the source and cutoff so imported data is distinguishable from live observation in every metric.

outcome.description: Structured outcome. Empty/unsupported measurements resolve to insufficient_data, NEVER to a silent zero or pass.

censoring.description: Censoring classification for the task at observation time.

left_censored.description: True when the task already existed at first trustworthy observation, so its state-entry time is unknown. occurred_at must not claim a real entry time.

right_censored.description: True when the task has not yet reached the terminal state of interest by the end of the window.

unknown_state_entry_time.description: True when the time the task entered its current state cannot be established from trustworthy data.

release_evidence.description: REQUIRED for release_recorded. A release is a verified production release per MDG governance, NOT a Hermes done card. Card completion, initiative completion, verification PASS, accepted candidate, and integration completion are each distinct and none alone constitutes a website release.

metadata.description: Free-form, redaction-safe aggregates only. MUST NOT contain card bodies, prompts, chain-of-thought, credentials, email, GSC query rows, or personal data.

then.description: Left-censored events must not assert a from_state.
Historical imports must declare their import batch (source + cutoff).
